title: Investigating the photophysical properties of rhodamines using a spectroscopic single-molecule fluorescence method
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38523-38529
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06577H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shangyuan Deng, Deqi Yi, Thitima Rujiralai, Qinghua Ren, Chuang Tan, Jie Ma
Using a custom spectroscopic single-molecule fluorescence (sSMF) instrument, three rhodamine species were distinguished within a single sample with RhB-2 exhibiting superior photostability.
